ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by high-intensity (white) pixels estimated at 85-90% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity (black) pixel borders along the leading and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity (white) region occupying the central and lateral lobe areas; secondary low-intensity (black) contiguous bands along the trailing edge margins and at the insertion point of the peduncle; minor focal dark clusters located near the central base and scattered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated 2D projected angle of approximately 50 degrees and a defined depth extending into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the full trailing edge consisting of high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel peaks and valleys (notches) isolated against the sea background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer lateral edges tapering towards acute points at the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters detected; notably a vertical alignment of approximately five small spots near the peduncle junction and isolated spots on the central-right lobe surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A vertically oriented series of four to five small dark punctate marks located at the midline near the base of the fluke.
